title: Rosemary Beach: The Happy House in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: The Happy House in Rosemary Beach.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Charming Coastal Retreat in the Heart of Rosemary Beach

Welcome to your next beach getaway! This beautifully appointed 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home is ideally located near the Cabana Pool and children's playground, offering easy access to one of Rosemary Beach’s most beloved amenities. With thoughtful design, comfortable furnishings, and a breezy coastal vibe, this home is perfect for families seeking relaxation and fun.

The first floor features an inviting open-concept living area filled with natural light, perfect for gathering and unwinding after a day at the beach. A spacious first-floor master suite offers privacy and comfort with a king bed, sitting space, and an en suite bathroom complete with a walk-in shower and a separate soaking tub.

Upstairs, you’ll find a second king bedroom with its own en suite bath, along with a fun and functional bunk room featuring two sets of built-in bunk beds and a private bathroom—ideal for kids or extra guests.

Step outside to enjoy a private outdoor space complete with a patio table for four, a cozy sitting bench, a gas grill for family cookouts, and an outdoor shower—perfect for rinsing off after a day in the sand.

Whether you're lounging by a community pool, grilling in the courtyard, or exploring the shops and restaurants of Rosemary Beach, this charming coastal home is the perfect place to make memories.

Key Features:

1st floor living space
2 king bedrooms with en suite bathrooms
Bunk room featuring 4 twins and en suite bathroom
Conveniently located on the park side of Rosemary Beach near the Cabana Pool
4 adult bikes included with additional bikes available for rent at Bamboo Bicycle Company
Complimentary court time at The Racquet Club
Complimentary access to The Rosemary Beach Fitness Center
Access to Rosemary Beach community pools and private beach walkovers

*PROPERTY REQUIRES A 7 NIGHT MINIMUM SATURDAY - SATURDAY DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER
